title: Tri-SDK auth matrix, retry diagnostics, and PullStream deprecation surface
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: Follow-on to the multi-SDK credential and streaming work — this PR standardizes a credential priming + retry diagnostic matrix across Python/TS/Go SDKs, improves ergonomics for PullStream consumers, and surfaces a deprecation path for the legacy PullStream resume API. Motivation: teams have reported inconsistent retry behavior when a token swap occurs during active streaming; additionally, our telemetry for retry predicates made it hard to correlate client-side retry decisions with server-side throttles. This change groups three coordinated efforts: 1) introduce an explicit "credential priming" handshake that SDKs can opt into to warm token caches prior to heavy streaming workloads, 2) add a compact, human-readable retry diagnostics payload that is emitted to SDK telemetry hooks (and to the Console events), and 3) provide a compatibility shim plus deprecation warnings for the old PullStream resume()/cursor style in favor of the newer resumable checkpoint API. Summary of changes (high level): - Python SDK: add CredentialPrimer class, expose enable_credential_priming flag on Client, add retry_diagnostics callback hook in async streaming client, bump package to 1.12.0-rc1. - TypeScript SDK: add credentialPriming middleware, small ergonomic changes to AsyncIterable stream consumer (stop() -> closeGracefully()), emit diagnostics to telemetry collector, bump to 2.8.0-rc3. - Go SDK: expose Primer interface and default implementation, add Diagnostics struct to stream events, update PullStream helper to log deprecation on first use, bump to v0.18.1-rc2. - Core: add compact retry diagnostics proto and Console wiring so events show up under "client-retries" timeline. Compatibility notes: - All SDKs include a runtime opt-in for priming; default remains off. - The legacy PullStream resume() remains available but now logs a deprecation advisory on first invocation; a migration guide is included in docs/ and linked in release_notes. Checklist: - [x] Credential priming implementations for py/ts/go - [x] Retry diagnostics emission to telemetry hooks - [x] Deprecation warning and migration doc - [x] Unit + integration tests for priming and diagnostics - [x] Console event plumbing for client-retries - [x] Docs and changelog updates Commits (summary): - 6f1d3b4 Add CredentialPrimer and tests (python) - 9b2a7e1 Add credentialPriming middleware and telemetry hook (typescript) - a1c4d2e Expose Primer interface and diagnostics (go) - 2c3f4b0 Add compact retry diagnostics proto + console hook - d5e6f77 Docs: migration guide and examples - 3a4b5c6 Fix flaky integration test: streaming-retry-timeouts Tests/CI: First CI run failed on python/integration/stream_warmup due to a timing assumption (test asserted metrics event ordering). Adjusted test to wait for priming ack and re-ran; subsequent run passed. E2E permutations: ran a matrix across py/ts/go client versions + server throttling mode (leaky-bucket/fast-fail) to validate that diagnostic payloads are emitted and that priming short-circuits the first-token-exchange latency spike. Files changed (high level): - sdk/python/redwood_client/credential_primer.py - sdk/python/tests/test_credential_primer.py - sdk/python/redwood_client/__init__.py (version bump) - sdk/typescript/middleware/credentialPriming.ts - sdk/typescript/streams/async_consumer.ts - sdk/typescript/telemetry/retryDiagnostics.ts - sdk/typescript/package.json (version rc) - sdk/go/primer/primer.go - sdk/go/stream/diagnostics.go - proto/telemetry/retry_diagnostics.proto - docs/migration/pullstream-resume-to-checkpoint.md - console/events/client_retries_handler.go - tools/ci/e2e/matrix-config.yml Review conversation (high level): - Jonah Kim (reviewer): Requested clearer guarantees around priming: what happens if priming fails? Author reply: Priming is best-effort; SDKs expose a priming_timeout and on failure we fall back to the normal token fetch path while emitting a diagnostic with "priming_failure". Updated README and added test that simulates priming failure. - Lucia Moreno: Asked to avoid noisy deprecation logs in high-throughput apps. Author reply: switched to a once-per-process deprecation counter and added an environment variable REDWOOD_SDK_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATION to silence. - Evan Zhang: Asked for a smaller default diagnostic payload to avoid telemetry cost. Author reply: made payload compact (enum codes + short reason strings) and added opt-out at init. Merge details: - Merge method: squash and merge - PR merged by: Jonah Kim - Merge commit summary: "Unify credential priming and retry diagnostics across SDKs; surface PullStream resume deprecation; bump SDK release-rcs." Release notes (user-facing): - SDK: opt-in credential priming to reduce first-request latency for streaming workloads (opt-in via enable_credential_priming / credentialPriming middleware / Primer option). - SDK: new retry diagnostics emitted to telemetry hooks and Console (human-readable timeline events). - Breaking changes: none by default; legacy PullStream resume is deprecated but still available. Migration guide: docs/migration/pullstream-resume-to-checkpoint.md
